entryStatus.guarded: Implemented conservative mapping with explicit gate; source correspondence remains unproved.
entryStatus.conditional: Only a narrow observed use is currently accepted; wider source behavior is not established.
entryStatus.refused: Known mismatch or missing domain proof causes conservative refusal.

entries.domain: Terminating pure computations in the supported Core fragment.
entries.refusal: Unsupported Core or translation warning; no independent correspondence proof exists.

entries.domain: Terminating pure computations in the supported Core fragment.

entries.sourceBehavior: Finite constructor trees; finite lists and tuples are observed componentwise.
entries.leanImage: Inductive constructors, List, and products with related fields.
entries.domain: Finite values with supported field types and no required lazy or bottom observation.
entries.refusal: Unsupported field type; potentially infinite generator; other unmodeled Core may fail translation.

entries.sourceBehavior: Haskell Int on a measured 64-bit target: signed wrapping arithmetic and comparisons.
entries.domain: GHC target reports intBits = 64; supported Int operations only.
entries.refusal: Non-64-bit target or unsupported machine number type.

entries.sourceBehavior: quot/rem truncate toward zero; div/mod floor; zero divisor fails; minBound / -1 overflows.
entries.leanImage: Hs.quotInt64, Hs.remInt64, Hs.divInt64, Hs.modInt64, and pair helpers.
entries.domain: Statically nonzero divisor and no possible minBound / -1 case.
entries.refusal: Zero or dynamic divisor; possible minBound / -1 overflow.

entries.domain: Finite ordinary range; actual construction must fit available resources.
entries.refusal: Potentially infinite enumFrom or enumFromThen variants.

entries.sourceBehavior: [a,b..c] can be infinite when stride is zero and c >= a; finite prefixes remain observable.
entries.leanImage: Approximate mode has Hs.enumFromThenTo; its zero-stride fallback is not faithful.
entries.refusal: enumFromThenTo, enumFromThen, enumFrom, iterate, repeat, and cycle are rejected.

entries.sourceBehavior: head, tail, last, init, (!!), maximum, minimum, and fromJust fail outside their defined domains.
entries.leanImage: Some approximate mappings use total defaults; these do not encode source failure.
entries.domain: No checked domain-condition mechanism currently admitted.
entries.refusal: Named partial operation is rejected even at an apparently safe call site.

entries.sourceBehavior: Machine width, floating-point rounding, and exceptional values are observable.
entries.leanImage: Approximate mode has mappings; no conservative relation is declared.
entries.refusal: Word, Float, Double, Int8/16/32/64, Word8/16/32/64 and primitive variants in checked types.

entries.sourceBehavior: Haskell Char includes surrogate code points; String is a finite list of Char.
entries.leanImage: Lean Char and List Char only for representable code points.
entries.domain: Representable characters and mapped operations with tested behavior; no lone surrogate.
entries.refusal: A surrogate literal is rejected; unsupported Unicode operations must not silently map to different predicates.

entries.sourceBehavior: The observed GHC isDigit is ASCII 0-9; other Unicode predicates can differ from Lean Char predicates.
entries.leanImage: GHC.Unicode.isDigit maps to Char.isDigit; other divergent predicates have no mapped image.
entries.domain: The observed isDigit mapping on representable Char values.
entries.refusal: isAlpha, isUpper, isLower, isSpace, isControl, isPrint and chr are not conservatively claimed.

entries.sourceBehavior: Newtype representation can erase, but class selection depends on distinct source types and dictionaries.
entries.leanImage: Current lowering erases type and dictionary arguments, with emitter recovery for some observed cases.
entries.domain: Only cases translated without warnings and satisfying current collision/instance refusals; no general source correspondence claim.
entries.refusal: Known ambiguous identities, unsupported instances, or emitted Lean errors must fail; other erasure risks remain open.
